about:
Mr. Plastic operates from Jonesboro, Arkansas, with additional locations in Little Rock and Fort Smith. The company is family-owned, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed. The business began as a local plastics store serving central Arkansas.

The company distributes a wide range of plastic rod, sheet, and tube stock, covering engineering plastics to sign plastics, and provides custom fabrication services. It emphasizes no minimum order requirements, no cutting fees, and weekly free delivery to customers in the region. The staff collectively brings over 50 years of combined experience in customized and engineered plastics.

Mr. Plastic serves industrial, engineering, and signage sectors, supplying materials for applications ranging from industrial components to sign fabrication. Its customer base includes local manufacturers, sign shops, and other businesses requiring plastic stock or custom parts.

The company differentiates itself through a family-service tradition, a no-minimum-order policy, free cutting, and weekly delivery, aiming to provide industrial-strength solutions with a local-store convenience.
